Officer's narrative
Responding to a report of a two-vehicle collision in Baytown, Texas, I found Driver 1 and Driver 2 in opposing lanes,
their front ends in contact after what appeared to be a low-speed head-on impact. Driver 1 reported striking the
steering wheel and feeling dazed, with symptoms consistent with a concussion. The force of the impact and the
occupant moevment observed at the scene align with that account. Front bumper and hood damage on both vehicles
matches the reported point of contact. Passenger was seated in the front passenger seat of Driver 1's vehicle, as
confirmed by my observations and two independent witnesses. Driver 2 agreed the collision occurred as Driver 1
described, and witness statements gave the same sequence. Scene photographs were taken. An inspection
photograph already on file shows a dent in the same area of Driver 1's vehicle before this incident, which I have noted
for the record. Driver 1 is a named driver on the policy covering the vehicle.
</page>
